question: In welchen Städten befinden sich unsere US-amerikanischen LCD-Lieferanten?
sparql:
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

SELECT ?city
WHERE {
  prodi:hw-A837-2549775 pv:hasSupplier ?supplier .
  ?supplier a pv:Supplier ;
            rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER (?name = "LCD") .
  ?supplier dct:publisher ?location .
  ?location a foaf:Organization ;
             rdfs:label ?country .
  FILTER (?country = "USA") .
  ?location void:void:inDataset <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/> ;
             wgs84:wgs84:location ?locationData .
  ?locationData wgs84:wgs84:city ?city .
}
